name: codex-project-flow
description: Install and safely upgrade a six-file schema-6 Codex workflow with unified protocols, immutable baselines, shared platform engines, and transactional recovery.

interface.shortDescription: Bootstrap, upgrade, and reconcile a permanent project workflow.
interface.longDescription: Adopts a permanent coordination-only project hub, deploys one unified runtime protocol, upgrades only the invoking task's current project, derives changes from immutable baselines, and reconciles visible tasks through bounded rollback-safe recovery.
defaultPrompt: Use $bootstrap-project-flow in this saved local project to install the workflow and adopt this task as its permanent hub.
Use $upgrade-project-flow from a task inside the target project to apply a task-aware upgrade with current-project isolation and bounded successor recovery.
